5. Appointments to Boards and Commissions [6:54pm]

6. Legislation for First Readings [6:54pm]
6.1. Ordinance 2026-15
Amending Title 2 of the Bloomington Municipal Code Regarding Establishment of the Fire
Merit Commission Council Sponsor - CM Zulich
Daily moved, and Piedmont-Smith seconded that Ordinance 2026-15 be introduced and read
by title and synopsis only. The motion received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Bolden read the legislation by title and synopsis.
Daily moved, and Piedmont-Smith seconded to discuss Ordinance 2026-15. The motion to
discuss Ordinance 2026-13 received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Stosberg moved and Piedmont-Smith seconded to postpone consideration of Ordinance
2026-15 until the next Regular Session to be held on July 29, 2026 at 6:30pm. The motion
received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
7. Legislation for Second Readings and Resolutions [7:01pm]
7.1. Resolution 2026-12
Establishing Rules and Guidelines for Alcohol Permit Districts Council Sponsor - CM Asare
Daily moved, and Piedmont-Smith seconded that Resolution 2026-12 be introduced and read
by title and synopsis only. The motion received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Bolden read the legislation by title and synopsis.
Daily moved and Stosberg seconded that Resolution 2026-12 be adopted.
Stosberg moved and Daily seconded to table Resolution 2026-12 indefinitely. The motion
received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
7.2. Resolution 2026-13
Authorizing Issuance of Bonds for the BHA Council Sponsor - CM Zulich
Daily moved, and Piedmont-Smith seconded that Resolution 2026-13 be introduced and read
by title and synopsis only. The motion received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Bolden read the legislation by title and synopsis.
Daily moved and Piedmont-Smith seconded that Resolution 2026-13 be adopted. The motion
received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
7.3. Ordinance 2026-12
To Amend Title 15 of the Bloomington Municipal Code Entitled “Vehicles and Traffic” to
Seasonally Provide a Carless Kirkwood Council Sponsor - CM Daily and Rosenbarger
Actions on Legislation:
Council Action (June 10, 2026): Passed Ayes: 5 (Asare, Daily, Flaherty, Rollo, Rosenbarger);
Nays: 4 (Stosberg, Piedmont-Smith, Zulich, Ruff); 0
Mayor Veto (June 19, 2026)
Council Action After Veto (July 22, 2026): Pending
Daily moved, and Piedmont-Smith seconded that Ordinance 2026-12 be introduced and read
by title and synopsis only. The motion received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Bolden read the legislation by title and synopsis.
Daily moved and Piedmont-Smith seconded that Ordinance 2026-12 be adopted. The motion
received a roll call vote: Ayes: 4 (Asare, Daily, Flaherty, Rosenbarger); Nays: 4 (Stosberg,
Piedmont-Smith, Rollo, Ruff); Abstain: 0. FAILED
